title: TodayWeather for iOS · Search from the header and unsaved places
scenario: Look up a place from a weather screen without adding it to your saved places, then keep it if you want. The images are the app's screens rendered in a window of the iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.5) by HeaderSearchManualCaptureTests, with the Seoul weather fixture and Korean controls; the place names are examples.

steps.title: Find the search button beside the place name
steps.instruction: On 시간별날씨 (Hourly), 일별날씨 (Daily) or 대기정보 (Air), look at the top bar. The place name is in the middle with a magnifier button after it. For your current position a location icon stands before the name. At the right, a saved place shows the bell for its alarms, then the share button.
steps.caption: A saved place: the magnifier after the name, and the bell and share at the right.
steps.expected: The bell is filled when the place has alarms and outlined when it has none.

steps.title: Search for a place
steps.instruction: Tap the magnifier. The same search as on 즐겨찾기 (Locations) opens with the keyboard ready. Type a name and tap a result. While the keyboard is up, the first tap only closes it; tap the result again to open it. To go back without choosing, tap 취소.
steps.caption: The search with results for 부산.
steps.expected: 취소 returns to the screen you came from.

steps.title: Look at the place without saving it
steps.instruction: The place opens on the screen you searched from. It is not saved: an outline star stands where the bell was. You can swipe or use the arrows to go to your saved places and come back to it. A link someone shared (link.todayweather.ai) opens a place the same way.
steps.caption: A place that is not saved: the star in place of the bell.
steps.expected: Only one unsaved place is kept. Another unsaved search result or shared link replaces it; a result or link for one of your saved places (within about 1 km, your current position included for a search) opens that saved place and keeps the unsaved one. It is gone after the app is closed and opened again. It is not in the 즐겨찾기 list and has no alarms or widget.

steps.title: Save it with the star
steps.instruction: Tap the star to add the place to your saved places. There is no confirmation; a short message says 즐겨찾기에 추가했습니다.
steps.caption: After the star: the bell is back, the place is saved and the short message shows.
steps.expected: The place is the last of your saved places and stays after a restart. Remove it in 즐겨찾기 with 편집.
